notes.content:
Hello, Anime tycoon is in beta since last two months and one major complaint from beta testers was how tedious build system is. Considering all feedback I decided to rework the existing system. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36515240/5b7d69cfdf39b16788045707b0ad89f4cb438eae.png

 Cut into an existing room.
 Undo through all your past steps.

New build of demo will available soon on discord :)

notes.title: Close Beta and Demo
notes.content:
Hello, Last post I made on January 14th now approximately six months later I am making a new post. During this period game went through many changes. I am doing a close beta test with few testers from today my plan is to release the demo on 13th July and if everything is fine release the game after one or two weeks. I will be gradually adding players from tomorrow to the 13th Of July for beta testing. You can contact me if you want to join the beta test, I will add send you the link. Please understand that the beta game is not as aesthetically pleasing and might be ridden with bugs that's why I am not allowing too many players at least for the next 2-3 days.

Now How the game is changed after 6 months.

Earlier there were three different levels once you reached a certain reputation and have enough money you can move on to the next level. But now as per screenshot now the game has a grid-based building system, Player can now build its own rooms and place objects there.
Now coming towards the room, the following 11 types of different room player can build in the game
      
        Animator Studio 
         Research
         Staff Room
         Toilet
         music studio:
         Graphic Studio
         Motion Studio
         Production Studio
         Talent Studio
         Training Studio
         School
         Writer Room
         Marketing



In research, you can research new technologies ahead of time, Writers room is used to make your own manga/story for your anime. As normally anime's are based on the manga's but this option gives you the ability to hire mangaka. Production studio can be used for mostly deal with the financial aspect of anime, getting a better contract to deal with merchandising, etc. Many real animation studio have their own school where they train animators you can use the school for the same purpose. Generally, marketing is handled by a partner but if you are self-producing anime it is better to have your own marketing studio.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36515240/4d8139406927cdb135bb4b79ecbfd873a3b5d4a8.png



Also, Overall Ui is changed now to support the new gameplay system, as you can see in the above picture. That's all for now. I want to apologize for missing date once again but it made the game much better then its previous version. I hope you will enjoy the game. On 9th I will share  how business simulation will work.

notes.title: Introduction
notes.content:
Every anime fan, dreams about making an anime. Fans love manga and wish for its anime adaption. 
Yet only a few have a real idea of what it takes to make an anime, only a few understand complex dynamics behind anime production.
Producing an anime is a laborious task, multiple companies and an enormous amount of manpower is behind every production.
With Anime Studio Tycoon I made an honest attempt to explaining anime creation in a fun way. I will explain many different parts of the anime production following weeks.

Anime Production Part 1
Anime production is very labour intensive, stakes are really high for every company involves in the production also it takes years to earn profit from anime. The total budget for an average of 12 episodes turns into $4-5million.
Only a few companies are rich enough to invest that much in a single show. If it flopped then they lost all money result into forming of production committee basically bunch of companies comes together and throw in few of bucks for-profit percentage. Following are different companies with different occupation comes together and form a committee.

 	Production Studio
 	TV Network
 	Ad agency
 	Merch licensing
 	Foreign Distributor
 	Domestic Distributor

Anime Studio Tycoon also follows the same pattern for creation. Based upon the reputation of your studio different committee will give you a contract. The main source of income of anime’s come by increased manga sales due to the effect of an anime also merchandising sales and DVD sales. Note that in such committee’s production studio didn’t get any royalty share from manga sales or merchandising but they get fixed budget for every episode and they didn’t need to handle other parts like paying for TV Slots or dealing with a distributor. Once your studio becomes big and has enough money you can create your own production committee by inviting other companies or producing anime alone.
In the next part I will share more about economy of anime production.
